source_text: Pope Francis of the Roman Catholic Church has repeatedly condemned FGM as an affront to human dignity and a violation of women's rights, describing it in 2022 as a practice that must be eradicated due to its harmful effects on the female body, which Catholic doctrine regards as a temple of the Holy Spirit. [68]
